title: What Each Keyturn Shield Host Plan Covers and What It Excludes
content:
Three of the covers carried under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan are written on some plans and not on others, and three exclusions are carried as switches on the plan itself. The table records, plan by plan, which of the six stands.

| Plan | Mechanical cover | Theft cover | Diminished value | Wear and tear excluded | Mechanical failure excluded | Unauthorised driver excluded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | no | yes | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | no | yes | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | yes | yes | no | yes | no | yes |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | yes |

### Condition and result

- Mechanical cover is written on the Keyturn Shield 75, 70 and 60 Host Plans, and on no plan above them.
- Theft cover is written on every plan except the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan.
- Diminished value is covered on the Keyturn Shield 70 and Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plans alone.
- Wear and tear is excluded on every plan in the ladder, as is loss arising while an unauthorised driver had the vehicle.
- Mechanical failure is excluded on the Keyturn Shield 90, 85 and 80 Host Plans; it is not carried as an exclusion on the three plans that write mechanical cover.

### Basis question

Where a host asks whether the theft of a protected vehicle falls inside the cover, the answer turns on the plan the enrolment is written on and on that alone: theft cover stands on the Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan and below it, and does not stand on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan.
